scientific_integrity: Symbolic proof of all-parameter formulas; eighteen finite checks are independent consistency tests and are not used as infinite certificates. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Proved for n>=2r+1 and fixed integer r>=1, one-types over individually named parameters; no smaller-n or higher-arity claim. Some earlier generalized-crown ideal enumeration was accessible only by abstract, so possible equivalent coverage is residual.
title: Uniform cyclic-incidence one-type spectra and a sharp algebraic growth law
